_comment: Trade goods and market events (docs/MASTER_DESIGN.md section 10). Prices are in credits per unit (1 unit = 1 ton of cargo). 'economy' multiplies the price on each economy type (below 1 = the planet produces it, so it is cheap and plentiful). 'tech' changes the price per tech level above 5 (negative = cheaper on high-tech worlds). 'stock' is how many units a normal market keeps. Salvage is scrap from destroyed ships (Milestone 4). Which goods are illegal is set by governments (world.json) and races (races.json).
_events_comment: Market events start at random on inhabited planets. 'prices' multiplies the price of a good while the event lasts.
